newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Empaq Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Empaq Q1 net rises.

text.p: Shr n.a. n.a. Oper Income 90.558 million 84.21 million Net 99.70 million 75.10 million
Full company name is Empaques Ponderosa SA
"This program will contribute to improving the marketability of the shares," Empaq said.
Earlier Tuesday, Empaq posted record quarterly sales volume of 38,970 tonnes of boxboard, up 9.1 percent from the first quarter of 1996. Of that total, 15.6 percent was exported.
Domestic sales volume grew 10.6 percent over the first three months of 1996, Empaq said.
Net income grew 34 percent to 330.4 million peosos, laregely because of the merger with Aluprint during the fourth quarter of 1996, it said.
